name: Zero-Sum Infinite Capacity Routing Obfuscation
description: Transforms the connectivity requirement into a network flow requirement where infinite capacity zero-sum routing on a subset of nodes is mathematically equivalent to those nodes belonging to the same connected component. This traps pattern-matching models into attempting to write Network Flow algorithms, while models that genuinely reason will deduce that this is just a disguise for finding a Steiner tree on the given tree.
